description: Lock the final price of one plan for a short time before you buy it. Use it after search_plans, with a product id from its results, and before purchase. Returns quote (quote_id, product, price, expires_at), mandate_precheck and wallet_precheck (will the purchase be allowed and funded), refund_terms and a next-step hint. It creates a quote but charges nothing and holds no funds; the lock lasts quote_ttl_seconds (see get_policies) and one quote buys once. Example: {product_id: "wh1-5838281"}.

agent_key.description: Secret returned by register_agent (or X-Agent-Key header)

principal_id.description: The principal you act for (or X-Principal-Id header)

product_id.description: Product id exactly as search_plans returned it in results[].id, for example wh1-5838281

name: get_quote
title: Get a binding quote
